parameters.prompt: A cute small robot actor, bright lime green all over with a cream belly patch, polished and professionally built, a friendly playful caricature. Its round head has a dark visor screen across the upper half showing glowing eyes and one raised glowing eyebrow, and the lower half of the head is a sculpted lime green clay face plate with a long, straight, prominent nose, a broad square jaw with a strong chin, and a wide confident toothy grin. Two small round cream ear pods. Short dark clay hair swept back on top. Its body is wide and top-heavy on one big coiled spring, caught mid-bounce, giving an enthusiastic double thumbs-up. A jagged lightning bolt sticks up from its hair. Polished, cinematic claymation short film look: smooth saturated matte modeling clay with subtle thumbprints, chunky rounded toy-like forms, soft warm theater lighting with a gentle rim light, shallow depth of field. Standing on a warm wooden theater stage in front of a softly blurred deep red velvet curtain, lit by a soft spotlight. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no badges.
